faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the Sr. Project Scientist post at IIT Delhi is 28 August 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Sr. Project Scientist at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Sr. Project Scientist post in the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi recruitment drive for 2026. Interested candidates should apply promptly.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need to apply for the Sr. Project Scientist posts through email. They should prepare their application with all required documents and send it to the official email address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Sr. Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The salary for the Sr. Project Scientist post ranges from Rs. 60750 to Rs. 79260 per month, plus HRA @ 30%. This is a contractual position with competitive remuneration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for Sr. Project Scientist at IIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Sr. Project Scientist position involves shortlisting of applications followed by an online interview. Candidates will be informed about the interview schedule after shortlisting.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Delhi Sr. Project Scientist Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications for the Sr. Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a 1st class Masters in Sociology/Social Anthropology, Gender Studies, Political Science or related social sciences, or an MA with 3 years of experience, with First Class. Strong research and writing skills are also required.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Sr. Project Scientist post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Sr. Project Scientist position is New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110016. The work will be carried out at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi campus.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIT Delhi recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IIT Delhi recruitment and related information is http://ird.iitd.ac.in. Candidates are advised to visit this site for updates and detailed notifications.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the Sr. Project Scientist position?
faq.answer: The Sr. Project Scientist position at IIT Delhi is contractual. This offers an opportunity for professionals to contribute to research projects for a specified duration as per the project requirements.
